title: Required-leg table for installed-client journeys
description: Client pins, profiles and leg rows. Table order is run order; every leg that consumes another leg's output names it in depends_on. Placeholders in argv, cwd and env come from a fixed whitelist (@MODULE@, @RUN@, @CFG@, @NATIVE@, @SRC@). Cross-references (row profiles, verification and order targets, the placeholder whitelist, run-relative paths) are enforced by validate_legs_table in tests/journeys/journeys.py, which mirrors this schema.

clients.description: Pinned clients; pins for clients a profile does not use are not required.

package_version.description: Pinned dpkg version; records must match exactly.

runtime_argv.description: Probe that prints the runtime version.

runtime_version.description: Pinned runtime string; records must carry it as a whole token.

phases.description: Phases that must be complete before check passes.

probes.description: Pinned probe sources; the engine verifies the bytes before any leg that compiles them.

sha256.description: Pinned SHA-256 of the probe bytes.

compile.description: Compile argv template; whitelist placeholders allowed.

run.description: Run argv template; whitelist placeholders allowed.

argv.description: One argv per leg; whitelist placeholders allowed.

cwd.description: Optional working directory; whitelist placeholders allowed.

env.description: Environment deltas; whitelist placeholders allowed in values.

exit.description: Expected process exit; nonzero for refusal legs.

absent_markers.description: Output substrings that must not appear.

other.description: Run-relative comparison path, required for equal.

expect_refusal.description: Present on refusal legs only: at least one of rv or markers must be non-empty, every given item must appear in the log, and empty output never counts.

markers.description: A markers-only refusal names a positive line printed by a helper.

requires_verification.description: The verifier leg that must pass for this leg to count.

verification.description: in-leg means the helper verifies its own output and prints the marker.

unchanged.description: Run-relative path whose bytes must not change during the leg.

depends_on.description: Legs whose outputs this leg consumes; table order is run order.
